sentences.en: Spacious apartments in Tokyo are hard to come by.
sentences.zh: 东京宽敞的公寓很难找到。

sentences.en: Spacious houses are more financially attainable than they used to be.
sentences.zh: 宽敞的房子现在比以前更容易负担得起。

sentences.en: The children occupied the large and spacious classroom.
sentences.zh: 孩子们占据了那个又大又宽敞的教室。

senses.zh: （房间或建筑物）宽敞的；无边无际的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：spac（看作space，空间）+ ious（多…的）→空间很多的→广阔的，宽敞的
